description: Get a single post by ID. `platform_post_url` is its public link on the platform; a Threads or Instagram post published without one has it asked for again here. A post that did not go out explains itself in `error_message` and `retry_count`; when the reason is `connection_lost` the account needs reconnecting before anything else will publish, and chirpie_list_accounts says which one.
name: chirpie_get_post
title: Get a post
